function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of custom event specifications defined in the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

page.description: The page number of the results to retrieve, starting from 1.

limit.description: The maximum number of event specifications to return per page.

filter.description: A string to filter the event specifications by name.

sort_order.description: The order in which to sort the returned event specifications.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos
function.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications, including their names, types, and descriptions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
function.description: Retrieve detailed information for a given list of event specification IDs, including both built-in and custom events. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_ids.description: A list of unique identifiers for the event specifications to retrieve information about.

include_details.description: A flag to determine whether to include detailed information for each event specification.

function.name: events_api_EventsApi_get_event
function.description: Retrieve the details of a specific event by using its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

eventId.description: The unique identifier of the event to be fetched.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_enable_custom_event_specification
function.description: Enable a previously defined custom event specification to start tracking the specified events. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

eventSpecificationId.description: Unique identifier of the custom event specification to be enabled.
